vicfalls.name: Mapopoma eVhitori
vicfalls.desc: Chimwe chezvishamiso zvinomwe zvenyika, mapopoma makuru pasi rose
vicfalls.summary: Inozivikanwa nemuno seMosi-oa-Tunya (Utsi Hunotinhira), Victoria Falls yakapetwa kaviri pakukwirira kune Niagara Falls. Nakidzwa nekukwira magwa, bungee jumping, nhabvu dzemundege, uye Devil's Pool inozivikanwa kwazvo.
quickFacts: Located on the Zambezi River at the Zimbabwe-Zambia border.
Approximate width is 1.7 km with a drop of over 100 m at its deepest sections.
Protected within the Mosi-oa-Tunya / Victoria Falls World Heritage landscape.
experiences: Scenic viewpoints, rainforest walks, and photography trails.
Adventure options such as rafting, bungee jumping, and helicopter flights.
Nearby safari and river experiences in surrounding protected areas.
vicfalls.bestTime: Chiratidziro chemvura yakakwirira chinowanzosimba kubva mumwaka wekunaya kwemvura kusvika mumwaka wekusanaya kwemvura; mwedzi-yemvura yakaderera inowanzofarirwa kune mamwe mabasa ekuita.

greatzim.name: Great Zimbabwe
greatzim.desc: Masvingo ekare anoratidza budiriro nehunyanzvi hwekuvaka hweAfrica
greatzim.summary: Yakavakwa pakati pezana ramakore rechi11 nerechi15, Great Zimbabwe ndiyo yaive guta guru reUmambo hweZimbabwe. Masvingo aya akavakwa nemabwe pasina dhaka. Nzvimbo iyi ndiyo yakapa nyika zita rayo.
quickFacts: Constructed and expanded between the 11th and 15th centuries.
Famous for dry-stone masonry built without mortar.
Represents the political and cultural center of the historic Zimbabwe civilization.
experiences: Explore the Hill Complex, Great Enclosure, and Valley Ruins.
Interpretive historical tours and local cultural storytelling.
Panoramic viewpoints over the wider Masvingo landscape.
greatzim.bestTime: Inowanikwa gore rose; mwaka wakaoma mwedzi kazhinji zviri nani pakufamba uye kuongorora nzvimbo.

kariba.name: Dhamu reKariba
kariba.desc: Rimwe remadziva makuru akaitwa nevanhu, rakanakira kukwira magwa nekuredza hove
kariba.summary: Dziva reKariba rakakura kudarika 5,500 square kilometers parwizi rwaZambezi. Rakakurumbira nekuredza tiger fish, maholide emagwa (houseboats), nekuvira kwezuva kunoyevedza.
quickFacts: Sits on the Zambezi corridor and supports both tourism and recreation.
Popular for boat-based travel, fishing tourism, and sunset cruises.
Connected to nearby wildlife areas including Matusadona-facing zones.
experiences: Game-viewing combinations with lake and park circuits.
kariba.bestTime: Mwaka wakaoma unowanzo kufarirwa kuona mhuka dzesango; zviitiko zvemudhamu zvinoshanda mukati megore rose.

rocks.name: Mabwe Anoshamisa
rocks.summary: Mabwe aya anoonekwa pamari yeZimbabwe uye anowanikwa munyika yose, zvikuru muMatobo National Park. Akasikwa nemamiriro ekunze mukufamba kwemakore akawanda.
quickFacts: Prominent around Matobo and other granite landscapes.
Featured in national symbolism, including currency imagery.
Formed through weathering and erosion of ancient granite outcrops.
experiences: Landscape photography and short nature walks.
Rock-art and heritage combinations in Matobo areas.
Scenic drives linking Harare and Matobo viewpoints.
rocks.bestTime: Kukwezva kwegore rose; yakajeka yakaoma-mwaka mamiriro ekunze kazhinji inopa yakanyanya kunaka kuoneka kwemifananidzo.

tourism.other_attractions_subtitle: Kunze kwenzvimbo dzinozivikanwa, Zimbabwe ine sango nemhuka zvakasiyana-siyana.

hwange.name: Sango reHwange
hwange.desc: Sango guru muZimbabwe, rinozivikanwa nemombe dzenzou dzakawanda.
hwange.summary: Rine nharaunda inodarika 14,000 square kilometers, Hwange inzvimbo yepamusoro yeSafari. Ine mhuka dzinoyamwisa dzinodarika zana nemarudzi eshiri mana mazana.
hwange.bestTime: Kuwanda kwemhuka dzesango kunowanzova mumwedzi yakaoma apo matsime emvura ari mashoma.

matobo.name: Sango reMatobo
matobo.desc: Nzvimbo yeUNESCO inozivikanwa nemabwe akaturikidzana nenhoroondo dzemweya.
matobo.summary: Matobo Hills ine mifananidzo yemabwe yakanyorwa nemaSan kare kwazvo uye ndiko kune guva raCecil John Rhodes pa 'World's View'.
matobo.bestTime: Inowanikwa gore rose; mwedzi yakaoma yakaoma yakanakira kufamba uye kuongorora.

eastern_highlands.name: Eastern Highlands
eastern_highlands.desc: Nzvimbo inotonhorera ine makomo, masango anoyevedza, nemapopoma.
eastern_highlands.summary: Dunhu riri pamuganhu weMozambique, rinosanganisira makomo eNyanga, Vumba, neChimanimani.
eastern_highlands.bestTime: Mwedzi yakaoma kazhinji inopa maonero akajeka uye mamiriro enzira ari nani.

mana_pools.name: Sango reMana Pools
mana_pools.desc: Nzvimbo yeUNESCO inozivikanwa nemadziva emurwizi uye safari dzekufamba netsoka.
mana_pools.summary: Inowanikwa muZambezi Valley, Mana Pools inozivikanwa nekunaka kwayo nemadziva mana makuru akaitwa nerwizi.
mana_pools.bestTime: Mwaka wakaoma unowanzo kufarirwa kune yakakwirira-density mhuka dzesango kuona.

nyanga.name: Sango reNyanga
nyanga.desc: Gomo refu muZimbabwe nemapopoma akadzika kwazvo.
nyanga.summary: Nyanga inzvimbo inoyevedza ine Gomo reNyangani neMutarazi Falls (mapopoma echipiri pakureba muAfrica).
nyanga.bestTime: Kwegore rose kuenda; nguva dzakajeka dzemamiriro ekunze dzakanakira maonero emakomo.

gonarezhou.bestTime: Mwedzi yakaoma kazhinji ndiyo yakanakira kuwana uye kutarisisa mhuka dzesango.

intro.p1: Tanga nenzvimbo dzaunofarira: mapopoma, maguta ematombo, mapaki emhuka kana madhamu. Vhura kadhi renzvimbo uone zvakakosha, mazano nezvinongedzo zverumwe ruzivo.
intro.p2_after_ar: kuti uwane ruzivo rwenharaunda nerondedzero kana uchida. Kamera nenzvimbo hazvimanikidzwi. Mienzaniso yezvauchashanyira inowanikwa usati wafamba.
intro.p3_between: kunogona kuiswa murwendo, kubva kusadza nemuriwo kusvika kunzvimbo dzekofi nezvekudya pedyo nedhamu.
intro.p3_after_cultural: kunowedzera nzvimbo dzenhaka, mimhanzi, zvivezwa netsika. Sanganisa izvi nenzvimbo dzemhuka zvinoenderana nezvaunoda, wozosimbisa kushanya nemuno.

energy.detail: GET.invest Zimbabwe yakatanga muna Chivabvu 2025 nemari yeEU neGermany yekutsigira simba rakachena. Simbisa zvinodiwa pazvino pachinyorwa chiri pasi.

agri.title: Zvekurima uye Kukosha Cheni
agri.detail: Zvirongwa zvemubatanidzwa zveEU zvinoisa pamberi pekurima horticulture uye zviyo zvechinyakare, kurima kwakangwara, kuchinjika kune EU zvinodiwa kunze kwenyika, uye kuwana mari kune agribusiness SMEs.

sme.title: Private Sector uye SME Finance
sme.detail: Chirevo cheEIB, 2 Gumiguru 2025: €60 million yakakweretwa kumabhanga eZimbabwe mumakore mashanu, kusanganisira €20 million kuStanbic munaKurume 2025. Izvi zvirongwa zvemabhanga zvekunze.

social.title: Hutano, Gender, uye Social Programs
social.detail: Zvirongwa zveTeam Europe zvinosanganisira kuenzana kwevakadzi uye zviito zvekusimudzira vakadzi, nerutsigiro runoshanda senge ruzivo rwemari uye nzira dzekuwana-mari dzevakadzi nevechidiki.

biodiversity.title: Biodiversity uye Resilience
biodiversity.detail: Kudyidzana kunotsigirawo kusiyana-siyana kwezvipenyu uye kusimba kwakabatana nekuchengetedza, kusanganisira nzvimbo dzekuchengetedza miganhu dzinoenderana nekusimudzira hupfumi hwenyika.

gateway.title: Pakeji yeGlobal Gateway Partnership
gateway.detail: European Commission inonyora €165 million yemipiro yekudyidzana neZimbabwe ya2021–2027. Iyi imari yekudyidzana, kwete yakaunganidzwa neDiaspora Unlocked.

eu_focus.eib_takeaways_title: EIB Inoshanda Yekutora kune Diaspora Investors
eu_focus.eib_t1: Mabhizinesi madiki anotungamirwa nevakadzi anowanzo tarisana nekukwanisa kubhadhara uye zvisungo zvechibatiso izvo zvinotadzisa kuwana zvikwereti zvepamutemo.
eu_focus.eib_t2: Mari yakasanganiswa uye mitsara yechikwereti yebhangi yemuno inogona kuderedza zvipingamupinyi zvekukwereta zvekurima-zvakabatana maSME.
eu_focus.eib_t3: Ruzivo rwemari uye masevhisi ekutsigira bhizinesi anovandudza kugadzirira kwekudyara uye kuita kwechikwereti kumabhizinesi madiki.

snapshot.title: Mufananidzo weKushanya weZimbabwe (2026)
snapshot.subtitle: Tourism iri munzira yakasimba yekudzoreredza, inotsigirwa neiyo iconic assets, kukura kudiwa, uye kuenderera mberi kwekuvandudzwa kwezvivakwa.

performance.title: Sector Recovery uye Mupiro

hero.subtitle2: Kubva kuShona stone sculpture kusvika kuma basket akarukwa nemaoko, wana zvigadzirwa zvine tsika nehunhu.

regulations.title: Gwara reMitemo neKutevedzera
regulations.subtitle: Mirayiridzo inoshanda yemitemo kune vadyari vediaspora, vatengesi vekunze, nevadzoki kumusha. Shandisai izvi serunyoro rwekuita basa, uye enzanisai zvisarudzo zvekupedzisira nenyanzvi dzemutemo, mutero, nechikamu chebhizimusi.

investment_compliance.title: Kutevedzera mitemo pakudyara
points: Simbisa chimiro chepamutemo chechirongwa, varidzi, uye hutungamiri hwebhodhi usati wapa mari.
Tarisa marezinesi nemvumo kuburikidza neZIDA nevatariri vechikamu vane basa.
Shandisa zvibvumirano zvakanyorwa zvevane migove nehutungamiri pakudyara pamwe chete nediaspora.
Nyora kwakabva mari uye ita KYC/AML kuvanhu kana masangano amuri kushanda nawo.

currency_settlement.title: Mari, kudzorerwa kwemari, nekubhadhara
points: Bvumiranai mari yekubhadhara (USD/ZiG/zvimwe) nenguva dzekubhadhara muzvibvumirano.
Tsanangurai zvakajeka migove (dividends) nenzira dzekubuda kune vanotora chikamu vediaspora.
Shandisa nzira dzemabhanga dzinoenderana nemitemo uye dzinotevedzeka pakufamba kwemari.
Isa zvinobata njodzi dzeFX nekutamiswa kwemari mumagwaro ekudyara (term sheets).

export_controls.title: Kudzorwa kwekutengesa kunze
points: Simbisa HS classification, zvinorambidzwa mumusika wekuenda, nemvumo inodiwa.
Chengetedza mapakeji ezvitupa: mavambo, phytosanitary, nemagwaro ehunhu.
Enzanisa kunyora pamapakeji, kupakata, nekutevedza chigadzirwa nemitemo yemusika wekuenda.
Shandisa vanotakura zvinhu necustoms broker vakabvumidzwa pazvigadzirwa zvinodzorwa.

export_certification_and_labeling.title: Zvitupa nekulebhela
points: Mapa chigadzirwa chimwe nechimwe kumazinga anodiwa musati matanga kushanda nevatengi.
Ita pre-audit yenzvimbo nemagwaro usati waenda kuongororo yezvitupa zvekunze.
Chengetedza lot-level traceability yezvekudya, wellness, nezvigadzirwa zvemaoko zvinotengeswa kunze.
Ita ongororo dzenguva nenguva dzekutevedzera mitemo kudzivirira kuvharirwa pamuganhu nezvirango.

tourism_entry_and_safety.title: Kupinda munyika nekuchengeteka kwekushanya
points: Tarisa rudzi rwevisa, nguva inobvumidzwa yekugara, uye kushanda kwemagwaro usati wafamba.
Iva neinishuwarenzi yerwendo inoenderana nemabasa aunoronga nezvinodiwa zveutano.
Simbisa nzira dzekubhadhara nemiganhu yekutengeserana kare.
Tevedza mitemo yemuno yemapaki, migwagwa, nezvekugara.

due_diligence_checklist.title: Runyorwa rweDue Diligence rweDiaspora
points: Kuongorora kambani, UBO checks, pamwe nekuongorora nyaya dzematare kana zvirango.
Kuongorora zvibvumirano pazvekutengeserana, mutero, nekugadzirisa kupokana.
Uchapupu hwekushanda: kushanya kwenzvimbo, mabhuku emari akaongororwa, nekuongorora vatengesi.
Kudzora kunoenderera: nguva dzemishumo, kutevera KPI, uye matrix yekukwidziridza nyaya.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: Nekushandisa papuratifomu iyi, unobvuma kupa ruzivo rwakakwana uye kutevedzera mitemo yezvemari neyekutengeserana inoshanda.
terms.p2: Zvese zvemukati zvekudyara zvine ruzivo uye hazviunze zano rezvemari.
terms.p3: Kuwanikwa kwepuratifomu kunogona kumiswa nekuda kwekushungurudzwa, chitsotsi, kana kutyora mutemo.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Isu tinounganidza account uye data rekushandisa chete yekushandisa chikuva, kudzivirira hutsotsi, uye rutsigiro rwemushandisi.
privacy.p2: Yako data inogadziriswa pasi pemitemo yekudzivirira-data uye haitengeswi kune vechitatu mapato.
privacy.p3: Kuti udzime kana zvikumbiro zvekugadzirisa, bata timu yerutsigiro yakanyorwa muzasi.

settings.title: Cookie settings
settings.description: Webhusaiti yedu inoshandisa makuki asingazivikanwe kukupa yakanakisa browser ruzivo uye kuunganidza akaunganidzwa manhamba. Izvi hazvibatanidzi makuki ekushambadza online.
settings.analytics_description: Yakagoneswa kutibatsira kuvandudza mashandiro uye usability.
settings.optional_description: Kuchengetwa kwemashoko anodiwa kunotsigira akaundi yako nezvaunosarudza. Ongororo yekushandiswa kwesaiti inotanga kana wabvumira. Unogona kuchinja sarudzo yako pano chero nguva.
settings.analytics_optional: Hazvimanikidzwi. Zvinotibatsira kunzwisisa mashandiro nekushandiswa kwesaiti.

consent.description: Webhusaiti yedu inoshandisa makuki asingazivikanwe kukupa yakanakisa browser ruzivo uye kuunganidza akaunganidzwa manhamba. Izvi hazvibatanidzi makuki ekushambadza online.
consent.title: Zvaunoda pamakuki
consent.optional_description: Kuchengetwa kwemashoko anodiwa kunoita kuti akaundi yako nezvaunosarudza zvishande. Unogonawo kubvumira ongororo yekushandiswa kwesaiti kuti tibatsirwe kuivandudza.
